findings.function: all functions using rocketStorage, rocketTokenRETH, casperDeposit or the prefetched keys
findings.decompiled: call 0x0 with: value call.value wei / static call 0x0.getBool(bytes32 key) / static call 0x0.getAddress(bytes32 id) with: args 0
findings.source: RocketMegapoolDelegate.sol:44-48 bytes32 immutable rocketDepositPoolKey ...; address payable immutable rocketTokenRETH; DepositInterface immutable casperDeposit; RocketMegapoolDelegateBase: rocketStorage (immutable)
findings.issue: The immutables read as 0 in this pre-deployment bytecode (solc): rocketStorage calls target 0x0, the rETH payment is a value call to 0x0 and the prefetched contract keys are 0.

findings.function: getNodeAddress(), calculateRewards, claim, distribute, stake, ... (49 lines)
findings.decompiled: def storage: ... validatorCount is uint32 at storage 3 offset 160 ... (no field at offset 0) / return address(stor[3]) / args address(stor[3]), uint64(lastDistributionTime)
findings.source: slot 3: address nodeAddress, uint32 numValidators, uint32 numInactiveValidators; function getNodeAddress() returns (address) { return nodeAddress; }
findings.issue: The address field of the packed slot 3 is not in def storage although getNodeAddress() returns it, so it prints as address(stor[3]) everywhere (P15).
findings.rule: When a slot is split into fields, give the low-offset field read as address(stor[s]) its own name (here after getNodeAddress, nodeAddress at storage 3).

findings.function: unknown0e335206 (getValidatorPubkey) and the other functions reading pubkeys/prestakeSignatures (7 pairs)
findings.decompiled: if uint1(stor14[_param1]): _2 = stor14[_param1].field_1 else: _2 = uint7(stor14[_param1].field_1) / if uint1(stor14[_param1]) == (_2 < 32): revert with Panic(34) / (the same five lines again for _3)
findings.source: return pubkeys[_validatorId]; (copy of a storage bytes to memory)
findings.issue: The length decoding of the storage bytes and its Panic(34) encoding check are printed twice in a row with the same inputs (P12); the second is implied by the first.
findings.rule: Common-subexpression elimination over pure storage reads with no store in between: reuse _2 and drop the repeated check.

notes: All 38 ABI functions reviewed (getters read; calculateRewards, repayDebt, deprecate, getPendingRewards and the debt functions compared line by line; stake, claim, distribute, notify*/dissolve/exit functions (330-607 lines) by structure). The source has no loop and the text has no while. calculateRewards' unchecked share arithmetic is printed distributed (tokenID * _2 - tokenID * r / 10**18 * _2, P9), exact modulo 2^256. Custom events and many getters are unnamed (not in the signature database).
summary: Faithful and fairly readable; besides the zero immutables, only the unnamed packed nodeAddress field and some duplicated storage-bytes decoding stand out.
